canonical_title: Learning/Training Strategy for Technical Competency: Course or Industrial Attachment (CBLM 7)
aliases: What are the 2 strategies for technical competency enhancement?
Learning strategy to learn new technology or industry demand
Location, duration and cost of technical competency training

one_line_answer.text: The two strategies for technical competency enhancement are training course/program and industrial attachment.

cites.quote: The major 2 strategies for technical competency enhancement are:

keywords.bn: gap পূরণের জন্য কোন পথে শিখবেন

bangla_explanation: Gap পূরণের দুটো পথ: training course-এ ভর্তি হওয়া, অথবা industrial attachment করা।
Industry-তে এখন চলা new technology শিখতে চাইলে industrial attachment বেশি relevant।
শুধু skills improvement দরকার হলে training course-ই যথেষ্ট।
Strategy ঠিক করার পর location, duration আর cost ঠিক করতে হয়; local industries আগে।
Strategy চূড়ান্ত করতে supervisor-এর সাথে consult করতে হয়।

example.en: A leather machine trainer needs a new stitching technology. He chooses a three-month attachment at a local leather factory.
example.bn: নতুন technology শিখতে local factory-তে industrial attachment সবচেয়ে ভালো।

short.prompt: What are the 2 strategies for technical competency enhancement?
short.modelAnswer:
The two strategies for technical competency enhancement are:
1. Training course/program: attend it for skills improvement.
2. Industrial attachment: more relevant to learn new technology used in industry.
The trainer consults the supervisor to finalize the strategy. Then he decides location, duration and cost.

keyPoints.text: One can get admitted to training courses or arrange an industrial attachment program.

cites.quote: One can either get admitted to some training courses or arrange industrial attachment program.

keyPoints.text: The trainer consults the supervisor to finalize the learning strategy.

cites.quote: TVET teacher/trainer should consult his/her supervisor to finalize the learning strategy.

keyPoints.text: Decide the strategy based on the nature of the skills and relevance with industry.

cites.quote: Based on the nature of the skills need to acquire and its relevance with the industry one can decide what kind of training strategy s/he should accept.
